review.why: The supplied Lab capture is Business Home, not this public-profile route, so fidelity is appropriately judged against the shared system rather than its discovery composition or the private phone-profile landmarks. Production preserves the graphite shell, mineral working surface, typography hierarchy, restrained borders and open media presentation. The work images retain visibly different source ratios, and the Story remains labelled Portfolio rather than being presented as publication proof. Recorded facts and reviews are readable and unboxed; verification and Instagram provenance remain independent. Follow, Report and the personal navigation are visible, with no private financial or vehicle information exposed. There is no reason to transplant the private profile’s phone masthead overlap or add a decorative source-to-commitment notch here. The only visible token mismatch is the Story sheet’s corner radius.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift is faithfully transferred to this desktop public profile, with visible personal-viewer functionality preserved and one minor Story-media treatment mismatch.
